cohort: The study included 395 mothers who gave birth by cesarean delivery in public hospitals of Awi zone, North West Ethiopia, in May 2023.
finding: The prevalence of postpartum anemia after cesarean delivery was 18.9%, and factors significantly associated with it included primiparity, malpresentation as an indication for C/S, pre-operation hemoglobin level <11g/dl, and medical complications during current pregnancy.
mod_finding: Malpresentation as an indication for current cesarean section was significantly associated with postpartum anemia.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from May 1-30, 2023, among mothers after cesarean delivery.
